subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A place where snakes are kept
solution:
The correct answer is **"Serpentarium."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Serpentarium"** means a place where snakes are kept. (वह घेरा जिसमें साँपों को रखा जाता है)

 
 
• **Example**: *The zoo has a **serpentarium**__ that houses a variety of venomous and non-venomous snakes.*
 
 
 
• The word is derived from the Latin word** 'serpens' **which means snake.
 
• It is a noun and is used to describe a facility specifically designed for the keeping and breeding of snakes.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, Apiary**, means a place where bees are kept. (मधुवाटिका)
 
• **Option 2, Hive**, means a structure where bees live and store honey. (एक संरचना जहाँ मधुमक्खियाँ रहती हैं और शहद का भंडारण करती हैं)
 
• **Option 3, Aviary**, means a large enclosure where birds are kept. (पक्षीशाला, दरबा)
